limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The contribution is exact bounded-symbol surjectivity of the radial eigenvalue map for Bdarneh's logarithmic Fock weight in every dimension, a bounded linear right inverse, and equality of the bounded-radial Toeplitz set with the full U(n)-commutant. Standard moment formulas, Laplace concentration, Fredholm and closed-range theory, Hahn--Banach, and the older arbitrary-eigenvalue result with generally unbounded symbols are not claimed as new. The result does not classify other radial weights, quasi-radial multi-parameter maps, optimal lifting norms, or uniqueness of symbols.
record_title: Bounded radial Toeplitz symbols realize every U(n)-intertwiner for a logarithmic Fock weight
